rules: Read this entire instruction document and every readingPlan range literally without truncation. Do not inspect failed reviews, their audit records, the other reviewer, production data, scores, or files outside this readingPlan. Use env -u OPENAI_API_KEY -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for all shell commands. Do not use network, paid API, Git, or new agents.
After complete reading, notify the controller and STOP without drafting or writing. Wait for authenticated reading release.

After reading release, prepare the complete review in memory. Every moveReviews and overallBlunderReviews rationale must be source-specific: identify the actual claim or reasoning and explain why a serious catalog definition fits or does not fit. A process assurance, a repeated template, or merely inserting a move ID is invalid. Include a substantive explanation even when no candidate is proposed.

Assess each catalog definition by its full wording. Do not use a label simply because its name sounds like a criticism. Every serious accepted and rejected candidate must remain in the final candidate tables, with precise source-specific reasons; no quotas or forced symmetry.

Before writing any file, emit your complete compact authored draft using functions text or notify. It must include moveReviews with moveId and literal rationale, overallBlunderReviews with blunderId and literal rationale, and every candidate row with identity, context, rationale and decision. You may emit it in bounded consecutive chunks. This is an unsaved draft, not a submitted output. Notify the controller after the complete draft is visible and STOP for the pre-submission semantic check.

After explicit final release, expand mechanical schema fields and accepted subsets without changing the approved literal prose or candidate population, validate the complete output with checkRhetoricalReview, and make exactly one apply_patch write to the designated ABSOLUTE outputPath. No other files are writable. Use a straightforward noninteractive Node heredoc for in-memory generation if needed; do not rely on btoa, interactive stdin, or functions-state surviving a new turn.

There is one exceptional replacement attempt in this fresh isolated context. Internal unsaved drafting may be checked before final submission; a submitted invalid output cannot be rewritten or retried. Preserve exact source and critique substance and do not calculate or view scores.
